text: No. I’d be going further than the injury suggests. Where it came from, and who handled it—that may help you more.
direction: Dr William Alden, an older English surgeon. Mature male calm low precise voice with an educated southern English accent. Unhurried and humane, factual rather than dramatic. Deep rounded older baritone with a softly resonant, finely articulated tone. Leave a small measured space between observations. Gentle descending conclusions; clinical precision without coldness or pomp.
